title: TFEU Article 101
notes: Binding treaty competition rule; agreement/concerted-practice analysis remains fact-specific.

title: TFEU Article 102
notes: Binding treaty abuse-of-dominance rule; dominance and abuse require market/fact analysis.

title: Council Regulation (EC) No 139/2004 — EU Merger Regulation
notes: Binding EU merger-control framework; notification/control thresholds and jurisdiction are transaction-specific.

title: Regulation (EU) 2022/1925 — Digital Markets Act
notes: Binding only within DMA scope; not a universal AI competition rule.

title: 2023 Horizontal Cooperation Guidelines
notes: Commission guidance for Article 101 self-assessment; standardisation/information-sharing analysis is contextual and non-statutory.

title: Competition Policy Brief — Competition in Generative AI and Virtual Worlds
notes: Commission staff policy analysis; market-structure concerns are not violation findings.

title: Joint Statement on Competition in Generative AI Foundation Models and AI Products
notes: Nonbinding joint enforcement-policy statement; each authority retains sovereign decision-making.

title: 15 U.S.C. § 1 — Sherman Act restraint of trade
notes: Current Office of Law Revision Counsel preliminary text; agreement requirement must not be inferred from parallel public statements alone.

title: 15 U.S.C. § 2 — Sherman Act monopolization
notes: Current Office of Law Revision Counsel preliminary text; market power and exclusionary conduct are fact-specific.

title: 15 U.S.C. § 18 — Clayton Act Section 7
notes: Current Office of Law Revision Counsel preliminary text; acquisition coverage and competitive effect are transaction-specific.

title: 15 U.S.C. § 45 — FTC Act Section 5
notes: Current Office of Law Revision Counsel preliminary text; does not convert every AI market concern into a violation.

title: DOJ/FTC 2023 Merger Guidelines
notes: Nonbinding enforcement guidance; current DOJ page in 2026 continues to list 2023 Merger Guidelines.

title: DOJ/FTC Antitrust Policy Statement on Sharing of Cybersecurity Information
notes: Current DOJ guidance list still includes this 2014 statement; cybersecurity analogy only, not an AI-safety safe harbor.

title: FTC Staff Report on AI Partnerships & Investments 6(b) Study
notes: Staff study based on three partnerships; identifies areas to watch, not adjudicated violations.

title: FTC/DOJ Withdrawal of Collaboration Guidelines
notes: Records December 2024 withdrawal; withdrawn guidelines must not be treated as current safe harbor.

title: DOJ/FTC 2026 public inquiry on business-collaboration guidance
notes: Public inquiry, not final replacement guidance. Comment period was later extended to May 21, 2026.

title: DOJ/FTC extension of collaboration-guidance comment period
notes: Confirms inquiry status and extended deadline; no final replacement guidance is inferred by R016.
